category_description: Pay, leave and government payments for people who work in the United States.
subcategory_description: The minimum pay and leave that employees are entitled to.
label: Hours in a workweek before overtime is due
context: Employees covered by the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA), unless exempt, must receive overtime pay of at least one and one-half times their regular rate for hours worked over this many in a workweek. The Act sets no limit on the hours employees aged 16 and older may work.

label: Weekly salary needed for the executive, administrative, and professional exemptions
context: Most exempt executive, administrative, and professional employees must be paid on a salary basis at not less than this amount per week and meet the duties tests. Nondiscretionary bonuses and incentive payments paid annually or more often can satisfy up to 10 percent of it.

label: Total annual compensation for the highly compensated employee exemption
context: Employees doing office or non-manual work who are paid at least this much a year, including the weekly salary level paid on a salary or fee basis, are exempt if they regularly perform at least one duty of an exempt executive, administrative, or professional employee.

label: Hourly rate for the computer employee exemption
context: Computer employees paid on an hourly basis can qualify for the exemption at not less than this rate an hour, as an alternative to the weekly salary level, if they meet the duties tests.

subject_intro: When federal law requires overtime, how the workweek is counted, which employees are exempt, and the salary tests for the executive, administrative, and professional exemptions.
